decisions.thought: Plan: Mirror match, same stats. Bring fast offense cycle: Mimikyu beats Chomp, Chomp beats Gholdengo, Gholdengo beats Mimikyu. Lead Mimikyu for Disguise safety, Gholdengo breaks Rotom, Scarf Chomp revenges. Watch for enemy Rotom wall and burn.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon team stats and speed tiers to select three members against a mirror team.Resolving the speed calculation and confirming identical mirror-team stats to determine turn order.Evaluating type matchups and coverage to narrow the three-pokemon team selection.Resolving the rock-paper-scissors cycle and Rotom-W matchup to finalize the three-pokemon core.Evaluating Mimikyu versus Rotom-Wash for the third slot and lead safety against the mirror team.

decisions.thought: Lead Mimikyu vs Kingambit. Use Disguise to Swords Dance free, then Play Rough. Keep Gholdengo healthy, Scarf Chomp to revenge. Enemy team unknown 2 more, watch Rotom wall.

Plan: Kingambit Iron Head threatens Mimikyu now disguise broken. Switch to Scarf Chomp to tank hit and EQ for KO. Save +2 Mimikyu lost but keep it alive for late sweep. Gholdengo still answers enemy Mimikyu/Gholdengo.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating damage with type matchups, STAB, stat boosts, and item effects under abstract output constraints.Comparing expected damage ranges against HP to assess the KO risk and survivability tradeoff.Evaluating Garchomp and Gholdengo switch options against Iron Head and EQ damage calculations.

decisions.thought: Plan: Scarf Chomp EQs Kingambit for KO. Save Mimikyu busted form broken but healthy for late sweep, Gholdengo answers Ghosts. Watch for Rotom-Wash wall incoming.
Plan: EQ Kingambit for KO, Chomp faster. Save healthy Gholdengo and 88% Mimikyu (disguise broken) for last two unknowns. Watch Rotom-Wash walling Chomp. Chomp at 11 HP likely dies to priority next.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating the locked-move constraint and confirming Earthquake KO on Kingambit before deciding.

decisions.thought: Plan: Both Kingambit and Chomp fainted. Send full HP Gholdengo to scout next two unknowns, preserve 88% disguise-broken Mimikyu for late sweep. Gholdengo Nasty Plot + Recover can win vs Ghosts.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating switch choice after both Pokémon fainted, comparing Gholdengo and Mimikyu states and opponent options.Resolving team composition conflict and choosing Gholdengo over Mimikyu for bulk and scouting.

decisions.thought: Plan: Foe Chomp likely Scarf EQ, outspeeds and 2HKOs Gholdengo. Switch Mimikyu tanks any hit, Dragon immune, then OHKOs with Play Rough. Preserve full HP Gholdengo for last unknown. Keep Mimikyu alive for sweep.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating speed and stat-reset tradeoffs to decide the next move with Gholdengo versus Garchomp.Comparing type matchups and damage to weigh Make It Rain’s power drop against Shadow Ball’s consistency.Evaluating Garchomp’s speed and Earthquake damage versus Gholdengo’s bulk and move options.

decisions.thought: Plan: Mimikyu at 8 HP doomed, LO recoil kills after any attack. Foe Chomp likely Scarf EQ and outspeeds. Sneak priority guarantees chip then self-KO to bring Gholdengo free. Avoid direct switch which eats super-effective EQ. Save full Gholdengo for Chomp + last mon.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Mimikyu's HP, Life Orb recoil, and stat reset after switching to determine if it survives attacking Garchomp.Comparing Play Rough and Shadow Sneak damage against Garchomp with Life Orb recoil and accuracy.Evaluating priority versus speed to ensure Mimikyu acts before fainting.Comparing priority move chip damage against a gamble for a knockout while preserving the switch-in.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: Plan: Gholdengo must KO 76% Chomp now before EQ kills. Make It Rain strongest neutral STAB vs Dragon/Ground. Cannot setup, EQ super-effective OHKOs. Hope 149 Spe outspeeds; foe hits hard so likely band not scarf.
